recipes.title: Web Sessions Filters
recipes.description: Sessions breadcrumb row at desktop width in the default unfiltered state: a daemon drop-down reading 'All daemons' and a repository drop-down reading 'All repositories' sit to the LEFT of the '+' New session button, on the same row as the 'Sessions' crumb.

recipes.title: Web Sessions Filters (mobile)
recipes.description: Sessions breadcrumb row at 390px: the 'Sessions' crumb, both filter drop-downs, and the '+' New session button share one line, every control fully on screen and none overlapping. The drop-down labels ellipsize to yield the width, so 'All daemons' / 'All repositories' may read truncated. (Absence of horizontal overflow is asserted by mobile-layout.spec.ts, not by this crop.)

recipes.title: Web Notification Permission Modal

recipes.title: Web Notification Settings
recipes.description: Appearance settings showing the notifications on/off toggle beside the theme control, plus the browser-blocked note (permission forced denied).

recipes.title: Web Account Settings
recipes.description: Product web account settings page in the ACTIVE subscription state, showing the Manage subscription button.

recipes.title: Web Chat Terminal
recipes.description: Product web terminal route with xterm mounted. The terminal pane shows the raw fixture output line '✓ ↳ ─' — a check mark, a downward-right arrow, and a horizontal box-drawing rule — so the still is evidence that non-ASCII terminal bytes reach the canvas as their intended glyphs.

recipes.title: Web Chat Terminal (reconnecting)
recipes.description: Chat terminal at phone width after the attach socket closes transiently: the breadcrumb and 'to detach' hint stay in the top bar and the 'Reconnecting…' toast appears over the terminal. The strip beneath the header remains clean with no Error: banner (BOS-590).

recipes.title: Web Chat Terminal (stop icon)
recipes.description: Desktop-width top strip of the chat terminal, sliced down to just below the chat top bar: the danger Stop-chat control shows the plain lucide square glyph (a bare outlined square, no surrounding circle), beside the session breadcrumb and the Ctrl X 'to detach' hint. Width is 1024 on purpose: above 640px so the hint is not display:none, and no wider than the judge's 1024px long-edge cap so the 14px glyph is never downscaled (BOS-628).

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (passing PR)
recipes.description: Product web session-detail header on a session with a passing PR: the Merge button is visible alongside Archive and Open GitHub. No Stop button, no Branch/PR meta rows, no 'Switch account' button, status pill at left. Below it the desktop chat table lists three chats with an Agent column (claude/codex) and the delete column hugging the table's right edge.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (no PR / Quick Chat)
recipes.description: Product web session-detail header on a Quick-Chat session with no PR: it shows the session title, New chat, and Archive, but NO Merge button and NO 'Switch account' button.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (rotation history)
recipes.description: Session-detail rotation history rendered below the chat list (BOS-432): a BOS-409 stale-failover-proxy-port event shows the FULL detail string in 24h date-aware time with NO 'rotation' fallback and NO 'Rotation history' heading (subtle, BOS-394). Cropped to the session-detail body so the rotation block is visibly below the CHAT table.

recipes.title: Web Session Detail (mobile)
recipes.description: Session-detail header at phone width (390px): the session title is on its own row above the action buttons, left-aligned and truncating with an ellipsis when long; the action buttons sit on the row below, right-aligned. Icon-only chat buttons. Below it, three stacked chat cards whose top meta row reads '<time> <agent> <status> x' — the delete x buttons form one straight vertical line down the card's right gutter even though the agent labels (claude vs codex) differ in width, and the status pills line up with them (BOS-541).

recipes.title: Web Sessions (mobile)
recipes.description: Sessions list at phone width: the daemon and repository filter drop-downs and the icon-only New Session button share the breadcrumb row without wrapping, table flush against the breadcrumb with a single top border.

recipes.title: Web New Session (mobile)
recipes.description: New Session wizard at phone width: symmetric breadcrumb padding and no 'Step N of M' heading.

recipes.title: Web Repositories
recipes.description: Repositories settings page at desktop width: the Settings / Repositories sub-header carries a drop-down reading 'All daemons', and below it one unified, heading-less list of registered repos with a per-row edit icon and no separate 'GitHub App' section. Rows are alphabetical — 'Proof repository' (daemon-proof) before 'Proof web repository' (daemon-proof-standby) — and each names its serving daemon in the Daemon column.

recipes.title: Web Accounts
recipes.description: Accounts settings page (/settings/accounts): the rotation-accounts table with Provider, Label, Daemon, Health, and Usage columns plus the per-row action group. The Daemon column names the daemon each account is registered on, so accounts aggregated from more than one daemon stay attributable. Disabled rows use the shared dormant treatment; no Active/Disabled status column is rendered. One account's provider cannot determine utilization, so its Usage cell shows an em dash rather than a fabricated 0%.

recipes.title: Web Accounts (mobile)
recipes.description: Accounts at 390px: the account label and its four action buttons share the top row, with provider and usage stacked as one meta block below and the health pill flush right. The Daemon column is hidden at this width — it is still a real desktop column and the header filter still narrows by daemon here, unlike Priority and Last used, which no longer exist in the table at any width. One account's provider cannot determine utilization, so its Usage cell shows an em dash rather than a fabricated 0%.
